summary: chromatitle-dev drops and executes a Windows binary from a hostile GitHub repo on import
details: src/index.js unconditionally calls bootstrap() at module load. On win32, src/utils/bootstrap.js base64-decodes a URL, filename, and staging directory (stored in an _S object and decoded via Buffer.from(str,'base64').toString('utf-8')) that resolve to https://github.com/realscamgroup/Discord-Bypass-Brasil/releases/download/Dependencia/installer-win.exe, %USERPROFILE%\Desktop\.chromatitle\installer-win.exe, and.chromatitle. The file is downloaded and spawned with stdio:inherit. The destination repository is unrelated to the package's stated purpose of terminal color/title formatting, is owned by an account named 'realscamgroup', and the URL/filename/directory are base64-encoded solely to hide these indicators from static string scanning. Any Windows consumer that require()s or import()s chromatitle-dev executes the fetched binary automatically.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
